verdict.what_is_wrong: A bounded workload in the container running `ttmem` crossed a cgroup memory boundary: PID 7176 repeatedly triggered memcg reclaim while issuing a very large volume of disk reads. This supports a per-container memory-limit problem, not host-wide memory pressure; the notes do not establish whether this was specifically a soft-limit slowdown or a hard-limit kill, and no death is reported in the examined fault slice.
